sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels) (1)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (werdenfels).
Our order history for this part shows 5.26 EUR (po:4500013373-10) against 5.84 EUR in the latest order (po:4500014427-10).
Our volume forecast for this part is up 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).
Your on-time delivery was 81.0% (sc:70740@2026Q3).
Today you supply 20 % of our need for this part, another approved source the rest. A binding 36-month commitment on these terms puts you first in line for a larger share.
We accept the AS-14404 index clause on the material share with a 5% deadband; the attached base price reflects the price risk this removes for you.
The attached package gives you planning certainty over 36 months.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 23,700 kg per year over 36 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.

Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. While we cannot share a detailed cost breakdown, we agree to include the AS-14404 index clause to provide planning certainty. 

Based on a 24-month contract and 14-day payment terms, we can offer a revised price of €5.50 per unit. Our current Angebot is a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are always keen to support your planning certainty and keep serving your needs from our extensive range. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

We acknowledge your revised offer and are prepared to extend the contract term to 36 months to support your planning certainty. In exchange for this 36-month commitment, we can offer a reduced price of €5.40 per unit. Could you please provide the documentation confirming the binding volume of 23,700 kg per year over 36 months? Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.

Alternatively, with a contract term of 36 months: €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Thank you for sharing the forecast data; please note that we had already incorporated this volume into our previous calculation. In recognition of your improved offer and to support your planning certainty over 36 months, we are willing to make a further concession. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Our current Angebot is a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

We can now offer a price of €5.30 per unit for a 36-month contract with 14-day payment terms and the AS-14404 index clause. Alternatively, with a contract term of 36 months: €5.30 per unit, a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
